predecessors.name: Kingdom of Kongo
predecessors.text: the Loango district on the coast, the seat Buali (Mbansa Loango)

ledger.x: c. 1550: the Kingdom of Loango, a state 'created by Kongo people', appears on the coast. The page gives the district's name, not a boundary.
17th century: the kingdom reaches its height.

c. 1883: Loango ends. Infobox 'Disestablished: c. 1883', 'succeeded by French Congo'; the text says only that 'Loango ceased to exist during the 1800s'. The French Congo page: 'formally established as the French Congo on 30 November 1882', confirmed at the Berlin Conference of 1884-85.

certainty.note: A coastal trading kingdom with no surveyed boundary; the 1884-1885 borders with Cabinda and the Congo Free State were set by treaties that neither page dates.
